svg.title: A-Commerce WBS Delivery Roadmap Gantt Chart
svg.desc: A WBS-level relative-week Gantt chart derived from the A-Commerce Product Delivery Plan and Work Breakdown Structure. It shows the 23 tasks from WBS-10-01 through WBS-80-04, explicit dependencies, their verified status, and illustrative relative timeboxes. The progress record was last reviewed on 2026-08-15. Every WBS item is verified, so there is no next task to execute; any new work requires separately approved scope that reopens the appropriate WBS item.
svg.metadata: Source of sequencing and dependencies: repo-specs/a-commerce/pdp-wbs.md, Work Breakdown Structure. Current status: repo-specs/a-commerce/progress.md, last reviewed 2026-08-15. Acceptance evidence: repo-specs/a-commerce/test-plan.md, Acceptance Scenario Catalogue and Release Gates. Relative timeboxes and intra-phase overlap are illustrative only. Specifications provide no effort estimates, durations, start dates, end dates, staffing plan, or calendar commitments.
svg.text: WBS-level tasks, dependency gates, illustrative timeboxes, and current verification status

g.aria-label: 图例

svg.text: No next WBS item is ready to execute: all 23 WBS items in the progress index are verified (last reviewed 2026-08-15).
When new work is approved, select the first non-verified WBS whose dependencies are satisfied; a reopened Phase 80 must follow its serial sequence.

g.aria-label: 执行规则and验收里程碑
g.text: 1. Skip work packages whose status is verified.
2. Among the remainder, choose the earliest item whose explicit dependencies are all verified.
3. Do not interpret bar width, row overlap, or week positions as durations, concurrency authorization, or calendar commitments.
Current result: no item is ready to execute. When new scope is approved, update the authoritative WBS and progress index, then apply this rule again.
Additional Phase 80 rule: 80-00 → 80-01 (Category → Product → SKU) → 80-02 → 80-03 → 80-04, strictly serial.
P30–40 · ATP-TEN-01 / ATP-INV-01 / ATP-TXN-01 / ATP-CPN-01 / ATP-EXP-01 / ATP-SNAP-01
P70 · ATP-FIA-01 / ATP-SPC-01; P80 · ATP-SPC-02 through ATP-SPC-05
WBS sequence and dependencies come from the PDP/WBS; status comes from the derived progress index and does not replace authoritative requirements or acceptance evidence.
